2022-2026 Council   Left to Right: Glen Frear, Tina Bennett, Mayor    
                             Eugene Runtz, Pietro Caputo & Randy (Joe) Kolida 
GOVERNANCE 
The BC Government sets out the legal framework for local governments primarily through the Local 
Government Act and the Community Charter. These two statutes establish the authority of the local 
government and provide direction for conducting municipal business. 
McBride’s municipal Council is made up of a Mayor and four Councillors. Members of Council are elected 
for a fixed four-year term. The next municipal election will take place on October 17, 2026. 
The role of the elected Council is to act as the governing body for the Village, making decisions that 
represent the best overall interests of McBride’s residents and businesses. In addition to planning for the 
future, Council considers all matters necessary to maintain and improve municipal operations and services. 
 
Council acts as a collective body and can only exercise the powers through resolutions and bylaws adopted 
in a properly constituted Council meeting. Mayor and Council also have a responsibility to provide 
community leadership, act as ambassadors, and to lobby on behalf of the Village.
